snippet.title: Orbs Orbs Orbs - Official Trailer | 2D Puzzle Game
snippet.description:
Wishlist Orbs Orbs Orbs on Steam! 🛒 ➡️ https://store.steampowered.com/app/3623400/Orbs_Orbs_Orbs/

Orbs Orbs Orbs is a vibrant 2D puzzle game where precision meets chaos! Clear the board by clicking to create white rings that destroy colourful, physics-based orbs — each with its own unique behaviour.

🧩 Key Features:

Six unique orb types with different physics

55 handcrafted puzzle levels

Moving platforms, gravity zones, destructible blocks, and more

ASMR-inspired sound design for a relaxing yet energetic vibe

Replay levels to beat your best score and time!

📅 Demo Launch: May 6, 2025
📅 Full Release: June 30, 2025 (after Steam’s Summer Next Fest)

🎯 Master precision. Embrace chaos.
💬 Wishlist now and get ready to play!

Support on Patreon: 👉 https://www.patreon.com/c/AcrylicPixelGames
Watch the development on Twitch: 👉 https://www.twitch.tv/acrylic_pixel

🎵 Music by Studio Chimp: https://www.instagram.com/studiochimp?utm_source=ig_web_button_share_sheet&igsh=ZDNlZDc0MzIxNw==

#OrbsOrbsOrbs #IndieGame #PuzzleGame #2DGame #SteamGames #Gaming
